title: Why do we go?

grammar.explainAr:
لبيان الغرض أو السبب (لماذا نفعل الشيء؟) نستعمل: to + الفعل المجرد بدون إضافات.
مثل: We go to school to learn. ويمكن أن تبدأ بها الجملة: To cross the river, they used a bridge.
examples: We go to school to learn.
We do sports to keep fit and strong.
Yousif wears glasses to see better.
They walked slowly to keep steady.

sentences: We go to school to learn.
We do sports to keep fit.
Kareem wears glasses to see better.
They walked slowly to keep steady.
They took a mountain train to reach the village.
We have holidays to rest and have fun.
